cevaplar.soru: how many characters shall a subscriber-chosen memorized secret be at least
cevaplar.cevap: A subscriber-chosen memorized secret shall be at least 8 characters in length. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: what length of memorized secret should verifiers permit
cevaplar.cevap: Verifiers should permit subscriber-chosen memorized secrets to be at least 64 characters in length. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: what is the publication date of this document
cevaplar.cevap: The publication date of this document is July 2025. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: what is the series number of this publication
cevaplar.cevap: The series number of this publication is NIST SP 800-63B-4. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: how often should reauthentication be repeated at AAL1
cevaplar.cevap: Reauthentication should be repeated at least once per 30 days at AAL1. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: how often shall authentication be repeated at AAL2
cevaplar.cevap: Authentication shall be repeated at least once per 12 hours at AAL2. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: who is the acting NIST director
cevaplar.cevap: The acting NIST director is Kent Rochford. (~ #doc:corpus)

cevaplar.soru: which OMB circular is this guideline consistent with
cevaplar.cevap: This guideline is consistent with the requirements of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Circular A-130. (~ #doc:corpus)
